_definitions.within_session_pearson_r: Pearson r between per-window estimates and reference rates within each session (valid windows only); mean across sessions.
_definitions.rmse_*_per_window: Per-measurement mean of per-session RMSE (same as audit/final_review_independent.json).
_definitions.rmse_*_session_median: Median across sessions of the per-session RMSE (typical-session value, robust to outlier sessions).
_definitions.mae_*_session_median: Median across sessions of the per-session mean absolute error.
_definitions.mean_within_session_ref_sd: Mean across sessions of the per-session reference SD (tracking difficulty floor).
_definitions.noise_floor: Complex white Gaussian noise, 200 windows x 480 samples (seed 20261011), passed through the identical downstream chain: Raw = autocorr_coarse->nls_estimate on bandpassed noise; HPSS = mitigate_hpss->bandpass->autocorr_coarse->nls_estimate. pct in [25.8, 81.5] uses the PAPER_18 reference range. rmse_hpss_vs_shuffled = RMS(est_noise_hpss - ref_shuffled) over 200 i.i.d. draws from PAPER_18 pooled valid refs -- the RMSE a pipeline outputting plausible-looking but uncorrelated rates would score.
_definitions.prior_artifact_note: This file regenerates audit/final_review_tracking_and_noise.json. The earlier untracked version contained 'rmse_*_session_median_of_radar' whose generating code was not committed and whose definition could not be recovered; it is replaced by the explicitly defined 'rmse_*_session_median' / 'mae_*_session_median' fields.
